# Bahria Town Karachi House For Sale

Buying guidance for houses, villas, apartments and flats in Bahria Town Karachi, Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan.
Open 24 hours. Call 0347 4825228 or +92 347 4825228, or message us on WhatsApp.
This site publishes no individual listings and no price figures. Availability and prices change often,
so current availability and prices are given by phone or WhatsApp. The contact form opens WhatsApp
with a prefilled message; it is not an email form.
